purpose: Single targeted A/B for Order 126 hypothesis 1: expose reusable current-video frame extraction by timestamp and active-presentation background-image mutation as direct generic Multi-Apps actions.
change_scope: Add parameterized Multi-Apps actions media.extract_current_frame and presentation.set_background_image. The first accepts a model-selected numeric or MM:SS/HH:MM:SS timestamp and output path, resolves the unique local video from live VLC state, normalizes only the documented time representation, and calls generic VLC frame extraction. The second accepts a model-selected zero-based slide and image path, resolves the active Impress URL from live state, applies the image, saves the same file, and verifies bitmap background state. Extend generic VLC media.extract_frame with an explicit time_seconds selector already supported by its frame extractor. Rank this two-action cohort only for explicit video-frame/timestamp and presentation-background-image intent. No task identity, dataset order, fixed path, expected image, golden material, evaluator state, Runner argument rewrite, or task workflow is embedded.

protocol.runner_guard_terminal_semantics: Internal guard termination records the reason and invokes the original evaluator without appending OSWorld FAIL; explicit model fail_task remains OSWorld FAIL.
protocol.on_failure: Preserve and strictly audit this single targeted A/B. Do not rerun it unchanged. Classify whether the remaining failure is action selection, timestamp/output binding, current-media resolution, frame extraction, background mutation/save, completion, or environment. Try at most two further materially different generic hypotheses only when the trace supports them; otherwise mark Order 126 task_blocked and immediately continue to Order 127.

implementation_evidence.failure_evidence: The untouched v134 baseline returned evaluator 0.0 after 30 steps and 473.278 total seconds. Qwen found nested vlc.media.extract_frame and libreoffice_impress.slide.set_background, but the frame contract exposed only frame_index/current_playback while the model repeatedly produced time 00:08. It extracted several current frames at the wrong moments, retried equivalent calls, guessed paths, and never invoked the discovered background action.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual_tests: Tests use unrelated Observatory Survey media, timestamp 01:17.25, slide index 4, and Observatory Review presentation/image paths. They verify timestamp normalization, live VLC uniqueness resolution, exact model output-path preservation, explicit VLC time_seconds extraction, active-presentation URL reuse, same-file save, bitmap read-back, scoped Top-K/search routing, compact contexts, and rejection of invalid timestamps, paths, and slide indices.
implementation_evidence.static_verification: Ruff check and modified-file format check, compileall, project layout/deployment leakage, frozen-v1 SHA256SUMS, frozen OSWorld commit, and evaluator-tree checks passed. Direct host invocation of guest integration tests was unavailable because no standalone guest service was bound; the targeted clean-VM run performs real deployment and health checks before the model request.

selection.method: single targeted A/B for the preserved Order 126 v134 timestamp-contract and tool-discovery failure
